about.title: Who I am
about.what: An engineer first, a software specialist by trade.
about.text: I work at nablify, an engineering and scientific‑computing company in Fentange, Luxembourg, where I build practical, user‑centric solutions that streamline engineering and scientific processes. I trained in electrical engineering before software engineering at ESIR, Rennes University, so I read a system from the hardware up.
